# panos-monitor attribution

The monitoring catalogue and selected rules were adapted into native Node.js modules from https://github.com/puww1010/panos-monitor at revision `09146cd68e394a0795c6296dfde30dea7139be0b`.

The local implementation changes collection boundaries, sanitization, health/coverage semantics, API compatibility, and report rendering. It does not execute the upstream Python runtime.

The upstream license is reproduced below.
